<div class="explore-intro">
This library brings together the main resources used throughout the camera-trap project, including software instructions, species-identification guides, data-processing workflows, and short conceptual guides for analysis.

Resources will continue to be added as the project grows.
</div>

::: {.soft-panel}
### Where should I start?

If you are working with raw camera-trap images, begin with **Timelapse** and **Species Identification**.

If you are beginning an analysis, review the relevant conceptual resources before calculating or interpreting summary metrics.
:::
